verdict.rationale: Pika's pricing page mentions concurrency and queue behavior only at the plan-feature level: the Fancy tier lists "Unlimited parallel generations" and "Priority queue". There is no documentation of concurrency caps on other plans, API rate limits, queue semantics, or batch-rendering guidance. missing for 10: per-plan concurrency limits, API rate-limit and throttling documentation, queue ordering/wait-time behavior, batch job submission and handling guidance, independent corroboration.
